cases.name: 1. Association endpoints: serves valid Android and iOS association files with correct content-types
cases.details: GET /.well-known/assetlinks.json and /.well-known/apple-app-site-association return valid JSON with correct headers.

cases.name: 2. Health checks: /health, /livez, and /readyz report healthy edge status
cases.details: Edge liveness and readiness endpoints return 200 with JSON status.

cases.name: 3. Legal resources: serves compliant HTML pages and CSS assets from public directory
cases.details: /privacy, /terms, /support, /privacy-choices, and /delete-account serve compliance documents from public/.

cases.name: 4. Callback contract: enforces OAuth callback parameter contracts for Google and Apple
cases.details: /auth/callback/:provider enforces code and state parameter contracts, preserving error reasons on cancellation.

cases.name: 5. Browser auth harness: connects, sets session cookies, and resolves identical PostgreSQL state
cases.details: Browser harness connects, issues session cookie, updates profile and cloud save into PostgreSQL, and resolves identical state.

cases.name: 6. Invariant verification: asserts zero new website or browser gameplay UI in apps/api
cases.details: Verifies that zero frontend framework components, game canvases, or new website UI were added to apps/api.

verification.summary: Future website foundations established in apps/api/routes/well-known.js and packages/services/browser-harness.js. Association files, legal routes, and OAuth callbacks active. Verified browser harness authenticates to the same platform while strictly preserving zero new website UI invariant across 6 dedicated tests on real PG16.
